name: get_open_times
description: Get the open appointment start times for one day, optionally for one stylist. Call before offering times.

name: update_booking
description: Save booking details the caller has given so far. Send only the fields you know. Returns the booking, missing fields and any problems.

description: Send the confirmed booking to the salon. Only call after the caller says yes to the summary. Returns a reference code or an error.
